description: Standing policies (WO-20261012-9b2c). An escalation is a record the routes table sends to the architect or the owner. A row here gives one kind of escalation a deadline and a default: if no record in answered_by lands on the ticket within deadline_seconds of the escalation, factory/bin/policy.sh writes a policy.applied record naming the row and wakes the seat. A kind with no row here waits for its answer without end. break.glass never has a row and policy.sh refuses a table that gives it one.

default.answer: Owner default: land the PR on its criteria as written. Prove only the change locally, leave the full suite to CI, add nothing the criteria do not name.
